content:
Overview

Nanchang is a city in Jiangxi with a population of 6,255,000. Capital of Jiangxi province, a historic city on the Gan River known for its revolutionary heritage and growing aviation industry. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
